+    return sd
+

+    return {"d1": d1, "d2": d2}

+

+    counter = 0
+    response = client.get("/")

+    data = response.json()

+    assert data["d1"] != data["d2"]
+    assert counter == 2
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
